title: Kinw Ferg Adventures
description: A simple mod adding a new entity called Ferg and a few structures.
body:
# We're back, baby!
Maybe not *fully* back with everything (e.g. updates) but back on the store for sure.

# Simple description
Simple mod adding a few silly entities, structures and other futures.


# Entities
| Entity |  Description                                                                                  | Image                                                                                              |  
|:------:|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|
| Ferg   | Miss-spelled frog that we can't stop thinking 'bout, he's got great legs haha | ![Ferg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbd279141e3b32f0c762016cfcb5310eea142224.png)  |
| Frong  | Miss-spelled frog that contruary to popular believe is not at war with fergs he's a transport | ![Frong](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12cb8fca5300eefba0604d27d89b253bc968c8e7.png) |
| Spidor | Miss-spelled spider, a being that came out of the shadowrealm itself to destroy the world as we know it | ![Spidor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93597e9c3b12bad6b64fa2c0dfab8e0b09d27027.png) |

# Creators' notes!

## Kliki
Ferg - as retribution for nearly crashing my laptop - will be used as a test subject for the **Kinw Space Program**
## NiktWazny-PL
Sorry for crashing out and abandoning the project for a few months, thx to kliki we're back on track!
